content.thinking:
The flag went on at 22:24:18, and errors seemed to track with it. Argus switched it off at 22:29:35, but the errors kept coming. The flag looked like it was flipping on and off every few minutes, so it may be evaluated inconsistently. My working conclusion is that the flag toggle is the cause, with a likely bug in spend_summary.

The bug at spend_summary.py line 47 is what the flag toggle is hitting, so the flag is the trigger.
